newsitem.title: USA: Nhancement weighing options on acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Nhancement weighing options on acquisition.

text.p: Nhancement Technologies Inc said Wednesday it was evaluating whether to go forward with a proposed deal to acquire C.C. & Associates, after its non-binding letter of intent expired by its terms on March 31.
Nhancement, a provider of voice-mail systems to companies that recently went public, said it was conducting the evaluation "in light of other business opportunities."
Douglas Zorn, chief financial officer of the company, said in a telephone interview that Nhancement was still looking at the possibility of continuing with the acquisition.
He said the letter of intent was included in the company's filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission and it had to report its expiration as required.
"We are looking at it but the expiration does not mean it (the acquisition) may not happen...it may happen in the future," he said.
C.C. Associates provides security systems and services.
